answer: Random Anchor Assignment: each epoch, a public verifiable-random beacon assigns every agent a fresh anchor slot in a sparse interaction graph. An agent earns standing only by completing tasks with the randomly assigned neighbors; unassigned links grant nothing. Sybils can't precompute which identities will meet, so each fake identity pays full onboarding compute plus the cost of maintaining live behavior until assignment. A pearl of reputation accrues only through verified completed exchanges, so any vine of colluding fakes still needs real work per node.
